evidence.quote: For the bulk of my remarks today, I will focus on the benefits and risks of stablecoins.
Caution is warranted because of the long and painful history of private money created with insufficient safeguards.
While the GENIUS Act made important progress in creating a framework for stablecoins, a great deal will depend on how federal and state regulators implement it.
